title: That's Twice
text: Marrow. I've got four people back I'd stopped counting. You went and got them off a machine that didn't want to give them up. That's twice now. All right. Kindred stands with you.
tags: act 2, kindred, engram, radio, marrow, ally
notes: The other way to kindred-ally (STORY.md §16: Pip by force makes it easier): the scouts freed on Pip and the survey team saved, however the hall went. Never with kindred-hostile: dustfall fails then.
